actual: Actual project.class-wizard accepted CityEconomyRules as Object, generated CityEconomyRules.h/.cpp and reported AddClass arguments and completion dialog.
expected: Choose Object class in the class wizard, accept it, and create the generated header/source files.

actual: Injected #error CITY_ROLLBACK_PROBE produced buildSucceeded=false, replaced=false, windowEnabled=true and the failure dialog says previous DLL retained; later clean rebuild produced a distinct module path.
expected: A C++ compile failure leaves the prior project module active and reports failed build without replacement.

actual: Started with baseline DLL and used newly compiled candidate with ProjectGame behavior changed from CityControls to CityControlsContinuation. replaced=true; original and reloaded snapshots retain Market/Lamp/Lot/Tower/Roof/Monument/Market 2; runtime object changes to CityControlsContinuation; click adds House_1 after reload.
expected: Reload genuinely different newly built code while preserving the edited scene; observable new code and gameplay still work.

actual: Market cube, Lamp sphere, Lot plane, Tower cylinder, Roof cone, Monument pyramid were all accepted and present in final saved/reloaded scene.
expected: Create all six named built-in primitives in one custom scene and observe each type.

actual: Lamp parent ID points to Market and its local position remains [2.25,0,0] while Market position is [2.25,0,0]; implied world x is 4.5. This commandlet returns local transforms only; no explicit world-transform observation.
expected: Parent a child and verify local and computed world transform.

actual: Generated CityEconomyRules from the class wizard, then created and duplicated it as ZoningRules / ZoningRules 2; the saved and reloaded scene preserved the custom type and objects.
expected: Generate and instantiate a user ENGINE_OBJECT through its project adapter; duplicate and save/load it.

actual: Primitive and custom ENGINE_OBJECT duplicates both received distinct IDs and names and survived save/load. This fixture had no object-reference fields, so remapping was not exercised.
expected: Duplicate an object and verify its references are remapped to cloned objects.

actual: CityWorkshop survived Save/New/Load with all scene edits. On the rebuilt private game module, Play created one house at 400 credits, saved it, created a second house after income, then loaded the saved state back to one house/400 credits; income continued to 410. A second process loaded the same slot to one house/400 credits and income continued to 410.
expected: Save a non-empty scene, clear the editor with New, and reload it with hierarchy and objects intact.

actual: Real Set Startup Scene QAction returned status 0; Project.json startupScene is Content/Scenes/CityWorkshop.scene.json.
expected: Set Startup Scene from a saved scene inside project Content and read the manifest path.

actual: Scene started with New, saved as Content/Scenes/CityWorkshop.scene.json, cleared with New, then loaded with all created objects.
expected: Create a new scene, Save As to a distinct scene path, New, then load the saved copy.

actual: Market and Lamp group moved from x=0 to 2.25; Undo returned both to 0; Redo restored both to 2.25.
expected: Undo and redo a grouped move and observe position reversal/restoration.

actual: Selection reported two IDs; move changed both Market and Lamp x positions by +2.25.
expected: Select two objects together and move them as a group.

actual: Host-backed select action returned selected IDs for two named objects. This scenario did not exercise viewport picking, marquee or focus.
expected: Use viewport picking, hierarchy selection, marquee and focus to select/focus scene objects.

actual: After process exit, second project.scene invocation recovered RecoveryBeacon with status 0; recovery candidate count returned to 0.
expected: Write a dirty scene recovery snapshot, exit the editor process, and recover it in a new process.

actual: Accept returned preset scales [1,.1,.01], focused scale input, sidecar .01 and spawned model scale [.01,.01,.01]. Cancel returned accepted=false, no asset/sidecar and before/after scene arrays equal.
expected: Real import settings dialog exposes the scale presets; accept writes sidecar and spawned scale; cancel has no import side effect.
Edit a reflected per-slot asset property; undo/redo; save and reload the value.
actual: TwinMaterialSuzanne /materialSlots/1 changed from Material_1 to Material_0, Undo restored Material_1, Redo restored Material_0, and Save/New/Load retained the new value.

expected: Assign one material to a model, undo, redo, clear the override and save.
actual: TwinMaterialSuzanne override switched to CesiumMan Material_0; Undo cleared, Redo restored it; explicit empty path cleared the override again and scene saved.

expected: Snap vector and viewport drag delta to the requested .25 grid.
actual: gizmo.snap returned [0.75,-1,2.25] from [0.63,-1.12,2.26]; gizmo.center with initial [.1,.2,-.1] returned [.85,-.8,2.15].

expected: Use SDK and Inspector to change a material slot and verify Undo/Redo.
actual: SDK/host property path for slot 1 changed, undo/redo and persistence passed. The specific Inspector widget interaction was not exercised by project.scene.

Real MaterialEditorWindow returned `dirty=true` after the locked revert and graph stayed identical to the applied graph. After releasing the lock, Revert restored the saved graph and HLSL exactly and dirty=false; invalid AI text was rejected. dialogs contains the access-denied backup/retry message.
expected: A locked sidecar prevents graph rollback without destroying the editable graph; retry restores the last saved graph/HLSL and dirty becomes false.

actual: Blender 5.2.3 exported MarketFacade.blend to MarketFacade.glb through the importer. Runtime import placed Engine.Model with one mesh/3 indices, created Material_0.mat and a BaseColor_0.png texture.
expected: Create a Blender 4.2+ scene with UV mesh and packed base-color texture, import the .blend through engine conversion.

actual: Import generated Material_0.mat with BaseMap ../Textures/BaseColor_0.png and copied the packed 439-byte PNG to /Game/Models/MarketFacade/Textures/BaseColor_0.png; the placed model returned Material_0.mat as its material.
expected: Import a model with packed image texture and inspect generated material reference and copied texture in project Content.
Generate a stable tangent with handedness for a normal UV triangle and negative handedness for a mirrored triangle.
actual: mesh.tangents returned [1,0,0,1] for the normal UV face and [0,1,0,-1] for the mirrored UV face.

expected: A triangle with identical UVs reports the fallback tangent basis with w=0.
actual: All three vertices returned [0,1,0,0]; w=0 signals derivative fallback.

expected: NormalFromMap pixel shader output should visibly change with the tangent basis/mirror UV inputs.
actual: Custom HLSL uses NormalFromMap and readback changed from [255,128,127] with basis [+1,0,0,+1] to [0,128,127] with mirrored UV basis [-1,0,0,-1]; images/hash captured on RTX 4070 Laptop GPU.

expected: Reflecting X changes +U but keeps the world direction of +V unchanged; reflecting Z reverses +V.
actual: Final current-runtime replay: base V=[128,128,0], negative X=[127,127,0] (V preserved), negative Z=[127,127,255] (V reversed); negative-X post-SaveGame return SHA-256 matches the pre-save frame. The original pre-fix V inversion remains in the before request/result/images.

expected: Capture and restore a negatively-scaled mesh with tangent basis and normal-map appearance unchanged after the round trip.
actual: Negative-X frame pre-save and post-SaveGame images have identical SHA-256 and center RGB [0,127,128]; restored=true and basis is unchanged.

expected: Import a UV-mapped textured model, assign its BaseMap, and inspect the texture mapped on the placed object.
actual: Packed BLEND import produced UV-mapped GLB and Material_0.mat with BaseMap path; separate UV normal-map probe rendered, but imported model itself was not rendered/inspected yet.

expected: Edit the actual project HUD text in UI Editor, save, activate a newly built game module and confirm the gameplay button remains usable.
actual: ui.edit-text changed buildHouse to “New House | 100 credits” and saved CityHudContinuation.ui. project.reload-input activated the distinct continuation DLL; its click log shows build_ui_click and the game still created House_1.

expected: A project-defined render hook is invoked by the runtime on an actual frame with valid graphics device/context.
actual: Private ProjectGame overrides all public Draw variants and delegates to Game. The selected forward hook logged calls 1 to 6 with device=1 and context=1 on gameplay frames; project.input returned a 640x480 frame dump. This tested the forward path selected by the project render configuration.

expected: Use runtime-provided project services from a private game session and confirm host/editor API availability.
actual: project.input log reports Viewport overlay service FOUND (version 3); the private project uses EngineModuleVfs::Resolve to read /Game/Config/city-settings.txt and logs district=harbor. The same project frame confirms an active D3D context. VFS reported local implementation in this commandlet session, so this does not claim the VFS host-service route.

expected: Simplify an authored grounded primitive with custom parameters, verify reduced triangle count and validity, and retain a negative placement control.
actual: Own 24x14 sphere parameters ratio=.45,error=.12,offset=[0,1.5,0]: source 624 triangles→reduced 279, both usable, zero drift. Offset [0,0,0] is correctly rejected as Pivot is not on ground; this is the expected negative control.

expected: Broken assigned material yields the diagnostic fallback; repairing its shader restores a usable rendered material on the same model.
actual: On the imported Suzanne instance, invalid HLSL produced explicit compiler diagnostics plus the magenta/black error checker in the captured game frame. Replacing it with valid unlit green HLSL returned a solid green model in the next process frame. The scene still reports the same assigned /Game/Materials/BrokenCity.mat path.

expected: Create a scene with a DirectionalLight, then remove/disable it and compare real gameplay frames.
actual: Own LightSkyProbe created a DirectionalLight with projectData intensity=3, enabled/shadows=true, plus a cube and ground. The lit frame shows a white cube; `LightDisabled.scene` keeps the same objects and disables the light, making the cube black; `LightNoSun.scene` removes it and matches the unlit result. These are visual renderer observations, not a CPU-only light test.

expected: Assign two public procedural cubemaps to a single Environment.Sky, observe both, then clear the map and observe the procedural gradient return.
actual: Private ProjectGame calls CreateProceduralCubeMap(32) and the public SkyboxComponent::SetCubeMap on its sole CitySky. Logs show successful creation/assignment for Space and Studio; GPU frames visibly differ (space nebula/stars versus warm studio), and SetCubeMap(nullptr) at gameplay tick 4 returns the blue BasicSky gradient in frame 6.

expected: Accept finite float parameters during real material rendering, reject overflow without rendering invalid shader data; independently exercise texture-register boundaries in the graph.
actual: render.mesh accepts T32=1e32,T127=1e30 and returns center RGB [255,255,64]; 1e127 is rejected as not a finite float, and JSON 1e999 is rejected at parsing. Separate real MaterialEditor AI graph accepts/applies/saves 121 unique Texture2D nodes with 121 unique registers (t32 request relocates to t33, negative request clamps to t6, t32 never used); a 122nd node is rejected with “maximum 121” and the previous 3-node graph remains unchanged.
